children: Saputo has restructured its leadership and operating units, including with the creation of a new ingredients division, to accelerate expansion of its capabilities in higher-margin dairy products.
The organizational realignment comes as the Montreal-based dairy producer pivots toward specialized protein ingredients and focuses on expansion across global commercial markets.

Under the new structure, Saputo said Wednesday that it has appointed Steve Douglas as chief operating officer of the ingredients business. He is currently COO of the company's U.K. dairy division, and will remain in that role until sale of the unit is complete, the company said.

At the same time, Saputo is embarking on an enterprise transformation initiative. It has appointed Haig Poutchigian to take on the newly created role of Chief Enterprise Transformation Officer, which will have him overseeing the integration of the company's business administration and operational finance, as well as information-technology teams, into a single enterprise-services model.

For its Canadian dairy division, the company has appointed Dave Paradis as chief operating officer. Among his new responsibilities, Paradis will focus on advancing the company's commercial execution and enhancing customer partnerships.

Saputo said the moves align with priorities it has pursued over the last few years, which include expanding its value-added-dairy and high-protein-ingredients capabilities, as well as leveraging digital and artificial-intelligence-enabled technologies.
